job: Make the massing/plan view persistent and live beside every guided step, so the home is always on screen while it is being changed.
context: The canvas already never unmounts - it is the export root, and BuilderApp keeps it mounted with a hidden/visible toggle rather than remounting (see the header decision note). Today the guided walk hides it behind panels on several steps. This node is about never HIDING it, not about mounting it again. The anti-yank contract is spec-pinned: data-load-epoch moves only when a whole document loads, never on an edit, and adding a persistent view must not change that.
rejectionGates: the 3D canvas must never remount when the step changes - a remount loses GPU state and the export root identity; prove it with a stable canvas element handle across steps
data-load-epoch must not move on an ordinary edit or a step change
mobile must not gain an automatically running 3D view (the existing mobile spec pins this)
instructions: 1. Give the builder a two-pane layout at desktop widths: the step's controls beside a live viewer, with the viewer persistent across all eight steps. Below the breakpoint the existing stacked behaviour stays.

2. Every step's edits must be visible in the viewer immediately - shell, rooms, openings, site, performance, materials. Where a step has no geometric consequence (Review), show the same view rather than an empty panel.
3. Prefer 2D plan automatically on the steps where plan is the honest view (Rooms, Openings) and 3D elsewhere, but let the existing view toggle override; never fight the person's choice.
4. Spec: a canvas handle captured on step 1 is the SAME element on step 6; an edit in each step changes the rendered geometry; the load epoch is unchanged throughout.

verify.note: run from app/; the orchestrator runs test:ui

evidence.closedLate: Shipped in b36b222; sat at 'ready' until Audit #9 finding 2. See the note in BP1-site-slot.json - this is the same bookkeeping failure.
evidence.delivered: A two-column builder stage at desktop widths: controls in one column, the live viewer pinned in the other and sticky while the controls scroll; one column below the breakpoint. The viewer is present on all eight guided steps.
evidence.hardGateMet: The canvas is the export root and must never remount. tests/builder-viewer.spec.ts marks the canvas element on one step and asserts the SAME element carries the mark on another; it also asserts the mark is absent after a reload, so the positive assertion cannot pass vacuously. data-load-epoch verified unchanged across all eight steps and after every edit.
evidence.defectFoundWhileTesting: The stage's implicit grid track sized itself to the canvas's stale inline pixel width after a viewport shrink and dragged the page sideways on a phone (expected 358, received 1392). Fixed with grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr).
evidence.scopeCorrection: The manifest asked for 'an edit in each step changes the rendered geometry'. That is not true of every step - comfort targets, finishes and the sun change the SCENE without changing the SHAPE - and asserting it would have required a signature that moves when nothing about the form moved. The pinned form instead: the viewer stays live and identical across all steps; edits WITH geometric consequence arrive immediately, including from the 2D plan; and a finish edit is asserted to leave the geometry signature exactly where it is, which is what stops the positive assertions from being vacuous.
evidence.gates: tsc clean; builder-viewer 3/3; neighbouring project-ui and plan-catalog-ui specs re-run 13/13; 63 UI specs on a fresh export build.
